items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: Club Desire booked all the bars. Louis Jordan, all of them at Club Desire.

ctx.x: And Good Rockin' At Midnight, all that. So, the boy was there. Club Desire booked all the bars. Louis Jordan, all of them at Club Desire. Joe Turner. Ivory Joe Hunter. Did you work there? I worked there many times. I didn't have with no damn band, but I worked there. Worked different little things. Big bands wouldn't come in. They used to hire all the local things, small things like me. Uh-huh. They hired them.
When did you start writing your numbers?
